entity: Louisiana State Parks and Recreation Commission
summary: The Louisiana State Parks and Recreation Commission concurs with the recommendations in the draft environmental statement and supports controlled ORV use in designated areas where minimal environmental damage would occur. They consider total exclusion of ORVs unsatisfactory and have no adverse comments on the statement, praising the thoroughness of its preparation.

statement.text:
STATE PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION
BATON ROUGE, LOUISIANA
P. O. DRAWER 1111 - 70821
PHONE 389-5761
WALLACE W. KING
June 22, 1972
G. Douglas Hofe, Jr., Director U.S. Dept. of the Interior Bureau of Outdoor Recreation Washington, D.C. 20240
RE: Draft Environmental Statement Implementation of Executive Order 11644 portaining to use of off-road vehicles on the Public Lands
·Dear IIr. Hofe:
The subject statement has been received and reviewed by this office. The concur with the recommendations and feel that on the state level, controlled use of ORV in certain designated areas value a minimal amount of damage to the environment would occur is necessary. Total exclusion of ORV are both unsatisfactory.
We feel that a thorough job was done in the preparation of the statement and have no adverse comments.
Sincerely,
· Gilbert C. Lagasse
Director
